description: This source file implements the server-side logic for the logout page in a SvelteKit project. It clears authentication-related cookies and local session data, then redirects the user to the login page. The file has been migrated from Prisma-based backend to a Django REST API.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Handles loading for the logout route; clears authentication cookies and session data, then redirects to '/login'.
